body.name: Cellwise conic dual
body.construction: Maximize \(\lambda t+\sum_xp_x[e_x\sum_j\alpha_{xj}\pi_{1x,j}+(1-e_x)\sum_i\beta_{xi}\pi_{0x,i}]\) over \(\lambda,\alpha,\beta\) subject to \(\min_{q\in[\ell_x,u_x]}\{(q-e_x)^2/[e_x(1-e_x)]-q\alpha_{xj}-(1-q)\beta_{xi}-\lambda(j-i)\}\geq0\) for all \(x,i,j\).
